locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; the source normalization, zero-Lebesgue-integral correction, and actual source Gram C^*C are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)]=[-L/2,L/2] with L=2*log(lambda) and Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi); e_t(x)=exp(i*t*x) is the dual evaluation vector
locked_conventions.inversion: J is reflection x->-x in logarithmic coordinates; Fourier residue classes are not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained at the inclusive endpoint, and lambda is never confused with lambda^2
locked_conventions.pole_signs: the inversion-even pole is +2|cosh(x/2)><cosh(x/2)| and the inversion-odd pole is -2|sinh(x/2)><sinh(x/2)|
locked_conventions.feature_space: V_r is the range in the declared target X of orthogonally projected physical polynomials of degree strictly below r; it is not identified with the physical prolate range
locked_conventions.strictness: a big-O scale, equality at a target threshold, shifted load one, or a nonpositive reserve is not a strict pass
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and decimal precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 inputs and JSON numbers are rejected
locked_conventions.input_limits: the finite oracle admits odd 3<=lambda_numerator<=999999 and 50<=dps<=1000, checked before integer conversion or interval initialization
locked_conventions.runtime_version: the interval runtime must report mpmath==1.4.1 exactly; a mismatch is rejected before any interval probe
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact finite-dimensional reductions, rational countermodels, and outward interval formula probes; no physical prolate angle, source-tail estimate, full weighted capture, or asymptotic theorem is certified
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms and derived formula probes use outward mpmath.iv intervals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.central_band: B_delta=[-delta/L,delta/L], T_B=integral_B |P_X e_t><P_X e_t| dt/(2*pi), and trace(T_B)<=delta/pi
locked_formulas.polynomial_feature_space: V_r=range(P_X restricted to polynomials of degree <r), P_V is its orthogonal projector, and alpha_r=||(I-P_K)P_V||
locked_formulas.conditional_source_scale: the unproved targeted bound ||(I-P_F)B_XP_V||^2=o(L/lambda^3) would imply alpha_r^2=o(L/lambda) and central trace o(L/lambda)
locked_formulas.odd_pole_tail: for p_-(x)=sinh(x/2) and its odd Taylor polynomial q_r of degree <r, epsilon_p_r^2<=L*lambda*(L/4)^(2*r)/((2*r+1)*(r!)^2)
locked_formulas.safe_integer_feature_order: the artifact uses r=3*bit_length(lambda_numerator), which is an exact integer majorant of 3*L/2 for lambda=lambda_numerator/2
locked_formulas.moment_geometric_remainder: for M_beta=qI-R, 0<=R<=(q-h)I, U_k-load is nonnegative and at most (2*||p||^2/h)*((q-h)/q)^(k+1)
locked_formulas.positive_excess_necessity: for p!=0 and A_plus>=0, M_beta+A_plus-2|p><p|>0 implies <p,A_plus p>>2||p||^4-<p,M_beta p>
locked_formulas.spectral_alignment_upper: with S=M_beta^(-1/2)A_plus M_beta^(-1/2), z=M_beta^(-1/2)p, and a_sigma=||1_[0,sigma)(S)z||^2, load<=(U_k+2*sigma*a_sigma)/(1+sigma)
locked_formulas.spectral_alignment_converse: strict load<1 implies ||1_[0,sigma](S)z||^2<(1+sigma)/2; the closed endpoint is mandatory in the converse
locked_formulas.claim_separation: central-band capture does not bound the exterior weighted defect, rank does not determine orientation, and neither conditional interval probes nor finite fixtures prove a physical prolate estimate
